verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no user-configurable, no-code builder for multi-step automations. The only no-code automation shown is a set of fixed behaviors (auto-start/complete Epics, auto-create Iterations, roll over unfinished Stories), plus story templates. These are adjacent preset features, not automations a product manager builds. The REST API is a developer building block that requires code, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code
